title: Share metric views with OpenSharing (Beta)
body: You can now share metric views with Databricks users in other metastores or accounts using OpenSharing. See [Add metric views to a share](/aws/en/opensharing/create-share#metric-views) and [Read shared metric views](/aws/en/opensharing/read-data-databricks#metric-views).

ref_links.text: Add metric views to a share
